Three India headlines from NDTV today, Sat 24 Oct:

Child rape case accused Veeramani's daughter deboarded from Singapore-bound plane. Veeramani, 84, chairman of Gem Granites, is in Puzhal Central Prison (1:36 PM IST).
Office vandalised, vehicles set on fire in Arunachal anti-dam protest. The violence followed claims that tear gas was fired at bandh supporters in Geku, Upper Siang, injuring four women on Friday (1:25 PM IST).
Six arrested for making fake notes, inspired by the series Farzi. The alleged mastermind was caught in Punjab after a 1,300-km chase (1:23 PM IST).
